subject: general
question: The famous Pandav Leni Caves is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandav Leni Caves:-**

 
 
• **The famous Pandav Leni Caves are located in the state of Maharashtra in India. (Hence option 4 is correct)**
 
• They are a group of 24 rock-cut caves that date back to the 3rd century BC and 2nd century AD.
 
• **The caves are located on the Trivashmi Hills, about 8 kilometers south of the city of Nashik.**
 
• The Pandav Leni Caves are a popular tourist destination, and are known for their intricate carvings and sculptures.
 
• The caves also contain a number of important inscriptions, which have helped to shed light on the history of Buddhism in India.
